outcome: coagulation parameters (ROTEM(r) parameters: FIBTEM A5, FIBTEM MCF, FIBTEM CFT, EXTEM MCF, CT)
cohort: The study included 185 healthy pregnant women of varying body mass indices presenting for elective caesarean delivery at term.
finding: There was no significant association between BMI and ROTEM(r) parameters in pregnant women presenting for elective caesarean delivery at term after Bonferroni correction.
cross-section timing: at the time of elective caesarean delivery
